problem:
The position vector $r$ of a particle $P$ (relative to a fixed origin $O$) at time $t$ is given by

$$
r=⟨7{t}^{2},\,-18⟩,\,t>0.
$$

Calculate the components of the velocity vector $v$ at time $t=5.$ Do not round the answers.

$v(5)=⟨${{field-1}},
{{field-2}}$⟩$
worked_solution:
The particle's velocity vector is given by the derivative of its position vector:

$$
\begin{aligned}v & =\frac{\text{d}r}{\text{d}t} \\  & =⟨\frac{\text{d}x}{\text{d}t},\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}t}⟩ \\  & =⟨\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(7{t}^{2}),\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(-18)⟩ \\  & =⟨14t,0⟩\end{aligned}
$$

To find the velocity when $t=5,$ we substitute into the above:

$$
\begin{aligned}v(5) & =⟨14(5),\,0⟩ \\  & =⟨70,\,0⟩\end{aligned}
$$
